description.value:
You choose one or more unattended creatures or objects within 60 feet with a combined weight of up to 15 pounds and hurl them 60 feet in a direction you choose; anything that ends this movement in midair immediately falls. Anything that collides with a target along the way, and that target itself, takes 3d8 kinetic damage; if the target is a creature, it may attempt a Dexterity saving throw to take only half as much.

Casting this power with a force slot of 2nd level or higher raises the maximum weight by 15 pounds and the damage by 1d8 for each slot level beyond 1st.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, Level 1
